name: browser-use
headline: baoyu-article-illustrator: Content Creation
short_description: The baoyu-article-illustrator skill enhances content creation by generating relevant illustrations for articles. This automation saves time for writers and marketers, enabling them to focus on crafting compelling narratives while ensuring visual appeal.
author: jimliu

sections.overview:
The baoyu-article-illustrator skill is designed to automate the process of creating illustrations for written content. By leveraging AI automation, this skill analyzes the text of an article and generates relevant images that complement the narrative. This not only enriches the reader's experience but also ensures that the visuals are contextually appropriate, enhancing overall engagement. One of the key benefits of using baoyu-article-illustrator is the significant time savings it offers. Traditionally, sourcing or creating illustrations can be a time-consuming task for writers and marketers. With this skill, users can quickly generate images that align with their content, allowing them to focus on writing and strategizing rather than getting bogged down in the visual creation process. This skill is ideal for content creators, marketers, and product managers who are looking to enhance their articles with visual elements without the hassle of traditional design work. For example, a blog writer can use baoyu-article-illustrator to automatically generate illustrations for each section of their article, making the content more engaging and visually appealing. Implementation of this skill is straightforward, making it accessible even for those with limited technical expertise. By integrating this AI agent skill into existing workflows, users can adopt an AI-first approach to content creation, streamlining their processes and improving productivity. Whether for personal blogs, corporate content, or marketing campaigns, baoyu-article-illustrator fits seamlessly into any AI-driven content strategy.
Automatically generate illustrations for blog posts to enhance reader engagement.
Create visually appealing marketing materials by adding relevant graphics.
Produce tailored visuals for social media posts based on article content.
Support educational content by providing contextual images that enhance understanding.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jimliu/baoyu-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Generate 3-5 illustrations for an article titled '[ARTICLE TITLE]'. The article is about [TOPIC] and targets [AUDIENCE]. Each illustration should be described in 1-2 sentences, including key visual elements and style. Ensure the illustrations align with the article's tone and key themes.
```
Copy

```
For an article titled 'The Future of Remote Work' targeting business professionals, here are three illustration concepts:

1. A futuristic office space with holographic coworkers collaborating, emphasizing digital connectivity and innovation. Style: vibrant, modern, and slightly abstract.

2. A split image showing a traditional office on one side and a remote worker's home setup on the other, highlighting the transition to remote work. Style: realistic and detailed.

3. A diverse group of remote workers from different parts of the world connected via a virtual platform, symbolizing global collaboration. Style: colorful and dynamic, with a focus on cultural diversity.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
